Double entry bookkeeping may seem daunting to learn at first, but the principle is simple and it gives you a clear picture of where exactly your money goes, if you're diligent about keeping it updated.

Every time you get paid, move $X from the Work Income account to the Bank account. Every time you buy groceries, move $Y from Bank account to the Groceries expense account. Every time you eat out, move $Z from Bank account to Entertainment - Eating Out account.

At the end of the month you can easily see which expense accounts are the largest, and you can zero them out by shuffling the required amount from a current year expense account. At the end of the year the expenses and income accounts get zeroed with the balance going to an equity (think net worth) account.

If you don't care to learn double entry bookkeeping, there are many other free/open source finance management applications out there which make things even simpler.
